attribute_consistency.definition: Unusual or internally inconsistent attributes in the listing itself: implausible area per bedroom, very large homes, rare configurations, coordinates far from the city centroid, or a ready-to-move flag that contradicts the construction status.
attribute_consistency.why_it_matters: Inconsistent attributes are where listing errors and misrepresentation concentrate; each flag is a prompt to verify that specific attribute, not a judgement about the property.

construction_status.definition: Whether the property is under construction (UNDER_CONSTRUCTION = 1) or complete (0).
construction_status.missing_handling: Missing scores the midpoint (half the weight) plus an 'unknown' warning.
construction_status.why_it_matters: Under-construction properties carry delivery, delay and completion risks that completed properties do not.

duplicate_counting_guards: READY_TO_MOVE is never scored separately: in the source data it is the exact complement of UNDER_CONSTRUCTION, so scoring both would count construction status twice. If a caller supplies READY_TO_MOVE and it contradicts UNDER_CONSTRUCTION, the contradiction is scored once, under attribute_consistency.
RERA and UNDER_CONSTRUCTION are excluded from information_completeness because their absence already scores under their own factors.
Location evidence uses locality frequency once; city identification enters only through the same factor's top tier, not as a separate factor.

information_completeness.definition: How many of the model's input fields are missing for this property, excluding RERA and construction status (those carry their own unknown handling, so counting them here would double-count).
information_completeness.why_it_matters: Predictions and risk statements built on partially imputed inputs deserve less confidence; completeness measures how much of this assessment rests on supplied rather than filled-in data.

location_evidence.definition: How much comparable-listing evidence supports this property's location in the training data, measured by the train-fitted locality frequency and whether the city was identified at all.
location_evidence.why_it_matters: Valuations are most reliable where many comparable listings anchor local prices; thin or unseen locations are where both the model and a human valuer have the least evidence.

method: Weighted additive score, 0-100. Each factor contributes 0..weight points; the overall score is the sum. Weights sum to 100.

calibration.provenance: Computed from the packaged model (optimisation-stage E01) on its untouched grouped test partition (n=4,284): absolute percentage errors grouped by PREDICTED price band (the quantity known at inference time). This is a calibration use of the holdout — it sets the uncertainty scale only and played no part in model selection.

prediction_uncertainty.definition: How far the ML valuation for comparable properties typically landed from the actual price, calibrated on held-out data: the 80th-percentile absolute percentage error for this property's predicted-price band, mapped linearly onto the factor weight.
prediction_uncertainty.scoring: score = weight x clamp((band APE p80 - 20) / (40 - 20), 0, 1)
prediction_uncertainty.why_it_matters: A point estimate without a reliability scale invites false precision; this factor prices in how wrong the model has demonstrably been on similar properties.

purpose: Property-level risk indicators assessed alongside the ML valuation, from documented, measurable signals in the listing data.
regulatory_construction_note: Regulatory and construction factors are scored separately from data-quality factors: a property can be poorly documented without being risky to build or buy, and vice versa.

rera_status.definition: Whether the listing data records RERA registration for the project (RERA field). A value of 1 means 'recorded in the listing data'; 0 means 'not recorded in the listing data'; absent means unknown.
rera_status.missing_handling: Missing/unknown RERA scores the midpoint (half the weight) and raises an 'unknown' warning. Missing RERA information is NEVER scored as non-compliance.
rera_status.why_it_matters: RERA registration is a verifiable regulatory milestone for Indian residential projects; its absence from listing data is a prompt to verify on the state RERA portal — it is not, by itself, evidence about the project's actual compliance, title or approvals.

resale_status.definition: Whether the listing is a resale (RESALE = 1) rather than a first sale (0).
resale_status.missing_handling: Missing scores half the weight plus an 'unknown' warning.
resale_status.why_it_matters: Resale transactions add a verification burden around the chain of previous transfers; the weight is deliberately small because resale is common and legitimate.

scope_disclaimer: ACADEMIC PROTOTYPE. This methodology scores documented, measurable indicators from listing data. It is not a legally verified due-diligence service and not a validated investment-risk model. The dataset and this module cannot confirm legal ownership, title clearance, encumbrance status, or regulatory compliance; RERA and construction fields reflect what listing data records, nothing more.
